en: A black‑and‑white postcard view over a small Alpine town nestled in a valley, framed in the foreground by a large tree and grassy slope. In the middle stands a prominent church with a tall bell tower rising above clustered houses. Mountain ranges surround the valley in the background. At the bottom border is a printed Italian caption identifying the scene, and at the lower right there is a handwritten date.
